sections.title: Chapter 7: Beyond Dimensions
sections.content: Legendary Summoner made his brief but actual appearance in this chapter, first seen when he deflects Shaiah's staff away as the latter is going to attack Tilith. Lugina tells him that he must return to where he was prior to this battle since there are more important things for him to do, Rin asks him if they will able to meet each again, he smiles before returning to where he came.

sections.title: Chapter 9: Fate of Bonds
sections.content: Legendary Summoner made his brief debut again together with Tilith at the very end of the chapter, and he is seen fighting an unknown enemy. With the assistance Lugina, Seria, Wallace and Hans; the five confronts against the great number of enemies, to Tilith's great worries.

sections.title: Chapter 10: Inherited Thoughts
sections.content: Legendary Summoner has made his major appearance in the final chapter of Brave Frontier II, and he is seen fighting against an enemy proficient in the power of Summoning with his and the latter's summoning clashed with each other. Seeing that the summoning could not work, he and the enemy charges to each other but is interrupted by someone furiously calling the enemy as Lestark. Lestark is not surprised to see Nigel came all the way chasing him down to Avulhein, and to hinder Nigel as well as the party's progress he summons the warrior who were served the gods before disappearing, Legendary Summoner together with Tilith then joins the battle with the Summoner and Rin against the summoned warriors. With the summoned warriors fell, he came into Tilith's protection when Lestark prepares to summon the enemies stronger than before. But upon seeing his adversary summon Creator Maxwell, Sealed God Lucius and Holy Emperor Karna Masta together at the same time, this shocked him as well as Tilith and Summoners of Old; it is told by Tilith that because Avulhein is the otherworld with no specific shape and form, it changes according to the strength of memories and will of the people in this world. Due to summoned Lucius and other two gods' strong will, the otherworld changes to St. Lamia Palace where Maxwell is fought, Grand Gaia Crater where Lucius appeared, and Empty Seal Menon where Karna Masta was sealed. As Summoner and Rin agree to lend him and Tilith their help to break through the summoned gods, he smiles out of gratitude before facing off against Maxwell.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- Legendary Summoner can be obtained as a free unit in Brave Frontier II, with his unit counterpart has two variants as the following:
- Legendary Summoner (Ex Deus Gladius) can be obtained by clearing "Battle of Summoning" stage in Rainbow Bridge at Avulhein, along with Tilith. This unit variant of him is Light element.
- Legendary Summoner (Summoner Robe) can be obtained by completing the certain conditions of obtaining Legendary Summoner (Summoner Robe) within the game. This unit variant of him is No element.
